title: Goliash
description: What runs where, drift, services behind upstream, delivery speed, image hygiene and the health of Goliash itself, from Goliash /metrics.

widgets.title: Behind upstream
widgets.description: Service × environment pairs behind the newest release by at least the tracked jump.

widgets.title: Open drifts
widgets.description: Drifts not resolved yet: env, upstream, inconsistent, declared, eol.

widgets.title: Oldest drift
widgets.description: How long the oldest open drift has been open.

widgets.title: Running versions
widgets.description: Distinct service × environment × version combinations running now.

widgets.title: What runs where
widgets.description: Running replicas per service, environment and version.

widgets.title: Open drift
widgets.description: Open drifts and how long they have been open, longest first.

widgets.title: Behind upstream
widgets.description: Services running a version behind the newest release, per environment.

widgets.title: Drift by kind
widgets.description: Open drifts by kind: env (environments differ), upstream (behind the newest release), inconsistent, declared, eol.

widgets.title: Behind upstream over time
widgets.description: Services behind upstream per environment.

widgets.title: Longest drift per service
widgets.description: How long each service's oldest drift has been open.

widgets.title: Deploys
widgets.description: Versions that arrived in the selected environments in the last 30 days.

widgets.title: Median lead time
widgets.description: Median of the services' median time from one environment to the next. Empty until versions move between two environments (e.g. staging → prod).

widgets.title: Slowest promotion
widgets.description: The longest median lead time of any service and environment pair. Empty until versions move between two environments (e.g. staging → prod).

widgets.title: Rollbacks
widgets.description: Changes back to an older version in the last 30 days: a deploy that had to be undone.

widgets.title: Deploys per service
widgets.description: Versions that arrived in the last 30 days, per service and environment.

widgets.title: Lead time
widgets.description: Median time a version took from one environment to the next. Empty until versions move between two environments (e.g. staging → prod).

widgets.title: Rollouts stuck or down
widgets.description: Workloads running none of the replicas they ask for, or two versions side by side for more than 30 minutes.

widgets.title: Rollouts that do not finish
widgets.description: Each workload whose replicas are not where they should be.

widgets.title: Hygiene findings
widgets.description: Images with a moving tag, a tag pushed again, an untrusted registry or no digest.

widgets.title: Findings by kind
widgets.description: moving-tag: latest, stable…; retagged: a tag pushed again with other content; untrusted-registry; unpinned: no digest.

widgets.title: Over budget
widgets.description: Images larger than the max_size_mb in their service's version policy.

widgets.title: Outdated bases
widgets.description: Images built on an older build of their base than the base tag has today: rebuild with --pull.

widgets.title: Oldest base lag
widgets.description: Longest a base tag has had a newer build than an image running on it.

widgets.title: Largest image
widgets.description: What pulling the largest running image downloads.

widgets.title: Image size
widgets.description: What pulling each service's image downloads, the largest per service: a jump is a heavier base or new dependencies.

widgets.title: Size against budget
widgets.description: Each service's largest image next to its size budget (max_size_mb).

widgets.title: Outdated bases
widgets.description: How long each image's base tag has had a newer build than the image is built on.

widgets.title: Image evidence
widgets.description: 1 when every running image has the evidence, 0 when one lacks it.

widgets.title: Layers
widgets.description: Layers in each service's largest image: a jump often means a Dockerfile lost its multi-stage build.

widgets.title: Median exposure
widgets.description: Median days production has run behind an available release.

widgets.title: 90th percentile
widgets.description: Nine in ten production exposures are shorter than this.

widgets.title: Behind 30+ days
widgets.description: Production services behind an available release for 30 days or more.

widgets.title: Behind 90+ days
widgets.description: Production services behind an available release for 90 days or more.

widgets.title: Past end of life
widgets.description: Production services on a release cycle past its end of life.

widgets.title: Accepted risk
widgets.description: Production exposures quieted by an acknowledgement.

widgets.title: Exposure over time
widgets.description: Median and 90th percentile days production has run behind an available release.

widgets.title: Longest exposed
widgets.description: Days each service has run behind an available release.

widgets.title: Licenses that need a look
widgets.description: Application packages under network copyleft, source-available terms, strong copyleft or an unknown license.

widgets.title: Packages by license
widgets.description: Application packages in running images per license class, from their SBOMs.

widgets.title: Exploited in the wild
widgets.description: Known vulnerabilities in running images that CISA lists as exploited (KEV).

widgets.title: Past CISA due date
widgets.description: Exploited vulnerabilities still running after the date CISA set for fixing them (BOD 22-01).

widgets.title: Oldest exploited
widgets.description: How long the longest-running exploited vulnerability has run.

widgets.title: Critical
widgets.description: Known critical vulnerabilities in running images.

widgets.title: Vulnerabilities by severity
widgets.description: Known vulnerabilities in running images over time: a drop is a fix deployed.

widgets.title: Agents online
widgets.description: Agents that reported in time.

widgets.title: Agents stale
widgets.description: Agents that stopped reporting; their targets keep their last state.

widgets.title: Snapshots pending
widgets.description: Snapshots received and not processed yet; a growing number means the server falls behind.

widgets.title: Failing notifications
widgets.description: Notifications not sent that failed at least once.

widgets.title: Background workers
widgets.description: Servers running the background work; must be exactly 1 per database.

widgets.title: Version
widgets.description: The running Goliash servers.
